title: A Second Halloween 🎃
excerpt: We're celebrating our second Halloween with a special seasonal theme, exciting changes, and improvements across Friends Remover. 🎃
body:
🎃 October 23 marks the anniversary of our very first Halloween update announcement, and now we're celebrating our second Halloween together! Friends Remover is getting another spooky makeover with a special seasonal theme and plenty of exciting changes.

👻 This update brings a fresh experience, new ways to manage your friends, improvements to notifications, and important upgrades to security, reliability, and performance.

🕸️ We've also made changes behind the scenes, refined the interface, and reworked parts of the extension to make Friends Remover smoother and more enjoyable to use.

Thank you for being part of our second Halloween celebration! Get ready to explore what's new and enjoy the spooky season with Friends Remover. 🎃

added.moreInfo: Introduced a gray default theme for users who prefer a neutral appearance.
Introduced a special Halloween theme, which is now the default theme through November 5, 2026.
Replaced the previous status filter with a dedicated Friend Filters system featuring multiple options for filtering friends in both the popup and Roblox's official Friends List page.
You can now remove individual friends directly from Roblox's official Friends List page.
Added Unfriend History directly to Roblox's official Friends page, making it easier to access and review your friend removal history.

You can now choose whether removals are allowed to continue in the background after starting a removal session in the popup. If background removals are disabled, closing the popup interrupts the session and pauses the removal process. When you reopen the popup, you'll be asked whether to continue or cancel the removal.

added.text: Untrust Friends from the Friends List
added.moreInfo: You can now untrust people directly from the Friends List, making it easier to manage your trusted friends.
Added translation support for the extension's context menu.
Removal ranks are now displayed in the Friends List.
Added a warning to the removal screen when Roblox is rate-limiting requests.

Introduced a dedicated Friends Remover notification system that saves notifications to its own database and integrates them into Roblox's notifications interface. Notifications remain saved even when receiving notifications is disabled in the settings.
If you've configured a PIN, you'll need to enter it before canceling a scheduled removal.

removed.moreInfo: Removed the Compact Viewer as part of the extension's ongoing changes and improvements.
Discontinued the friend reporting system due to limited usage. Friends Remover will continue focusing on helping users manage and remove friends efficiently.
Removed friend status displays due to the additional API requests they generated and their limited usefulness.
Removed Block Mode in favor of Free Mode.
Removed the tutorial as part of the extension's ongoing interface changes.
Removed the duplicate Refresh action from the friends-load error screen. Try Again is now the only recovery button and still clears the cache before retrying the status check.
Removed resource-intensive animations to reduce unnecessary popup processing and improve performance.

removed.text: Mutual Friends Viewer from the Removal Screen
removed.moreInfo: Removed the Mutual Friends Viewer from the removal screen when Mutual Mode is enabled.
Removed emojis from theme names for a cleaner and more consistent theme selection interface.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed an issue that prevented the settings menu from working correctly on mobile devices.

fixed.text: Search, Filter, and Quick Action Controls
fixed.moreInfo: Fixed an issue where multiple controls could remain open simultaneously. Opening Search, Filter, Quick Actions, or the three-dots menu now closes the previously open control without disabling the newly selected one.
Fixed an extra line appearing in welcome messages in the menu.
Fixed the Mutual Viewer layout so it correctly starts at the top of the profile frame and extends to the bottom.
Fixed refreshing the Friends List Viewer so it stays open instead of returning users to the main menu.

Fixed missing failure notifications when removing fewer than five friends. Small batches use a toast instead of the full removal screen, and the toast now correctly reports failures and rate limiting.

Implemented worker-enforced removal locking, disabled removal controls during active runs, persistent status tracking for small batches, and shared rate limiting across manual and automated removals to prevent conflicting removal processes.
Fixed several settings that were not initializing or starting correctly.
Fixed an issue where FR Plus removal speed settings could disappear when refreshing the settings.
Fixed an issue where your own friend removals could incorrectly trigger or toggle notifications intended for unexpected removals.

improved.moreInfo: Updated the icons used for removal ranks.
Optimized image assets to reduce excessive memory usage caused by unnecessarily large images.
Replaced the old extension logo with the new logo.
Improved theme selection loading speed so selecting a theme is now quicker.
The pin button is no longer displayed for trusted friends, preventing unnecessary pinning actions for people who are already trusted.
Increased the menu headshot size from 110px to 120px.
Reduced the gap between the welcome message and the menu buttons from 24px to 12px.
The Refresh button in the Friends List now displays a loading screen while refreshing.
Improved rate-limit detection so the extension can identify rate limiting earlier and determine when to pause and resume removal requests.
Improved coordination between manual and automated removals, including shared rate-limit handling, active-run locking, and more reliable removal status tracking.

Strengthened Notes moderation and patched multiple text-filter bypasses. The system now issues warnings for content that mocks or makes light of tragic events, including September 11 and the death of Charlie Kirk.
Updated the font used throughout the popup to Builder Sans for a more consistent visual experience.
Increased the chance of a suggested pin appearing from 25% to 65%, making pin suggestions considerably more frequent.

Fully enforced the three-day friendship requirement across Friends Remover. Friends must have been on your friends list for at least three days before they can be pinned, and this restriction is enforced everywhere throughout the extension.
Updated the Block Mode interface and toast notifications for a more consistent user experience.

Renamed 'Notify if friend was removed from friends list' to 'Notify if friend randomly removed' to make the setting's purpose clearer. Improved its behavior to ensure removals you initiate yourself don't trigger random-removal alerts.
Improved removal progress calculations so the displayed progress is more accurate and no longer fluctuates unnecessarily.
Improved removal time estimates to provide more accurate predictions of how long a removal session will take.
Added missing translations for several settings to improve the extension's multilingual experience.
